evidence.mission_note: A manual sport-package 3.0i with hardtop squarely matches the enthusiast-bridge brief and sits under the ceiling. Its fit depends on proving cooling and subframe health remotely at a price above the comps.
evidence.rationale: The photos establish a stock-appearing, manual-transmission Z3 3.0i roadster in Titanium Silver over black, with sport-package cross-spoke wheels, an M steering wheel and an included hardtop. The visible paint, dash and leather are in good order. Mileage (49,000), clean title, clean Carfax and 'all service records' are seller claims only. No VIN, records, odometer, engine-bay, underside or trunk-floor images are provided. Both model-critical items, rear subframe/trunk-floor integrity and cooling-system history, are missing on a 24-year-old car from a salt-belt state. Nothing wrong is observed in the attached photos. The asking price of $19,500 firm is above the $12,185–$15,526 fair-value band and above a near-identical 2002 roadster that sold for $17,995 in NJ. The listing has been up about 11 weeks and was relisted unchanged.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, the Carfax, scans of the service records, tire date codes and trunk-floor/subframe photos, and ask whether he will allow a PPI at a BMW independent near Ephrata.
